groups.name: YouTube
groups.description: YouTube web, music, kids, thumbnails and video delivery hosts that can be listed explicitly.
notes: Hosts files have no wildcards. Video bytes are served from many hosts such as rN---sn-xxxx.googlevideo.com that cannot be listed, so playback of an already-loaded page may continue until the DNS layer (M3).
ytimg.com (apex) does not resolve, so the hosts layer gets a harmless entry for it; it is listed so the DNS layer blocks every *.ytimg.com host.

accounts.youtube.com and consent.youtube.com are deliberately NOT in the hosts list and are listed under allow: they are shared Google sign-in and consent endpoints, so the DNS layer (which blocks whole domains) lets them through.
www.youtu.be returns NXDOMAIN and is not listed.
